subject.title: fix(feishu): cancel agent runs when source messages are recalled

question: Should Feishu source-message recall—and the narrowly scoped 231003 missing-typing-target fallback—be accepted as a default instruction to abort an active source-bound agent run and suppress its replies?
rationale: The patch adds a user-visible cancellation policy rather than only repairing a documented existing channel contract; tests establish mechanics, but maintainer intent determines whether this default is the desired channel behavior.

options.title: Approve Feishu-local cancellation
options.body: Accept recall as cancellation for Feishu source-bound work after current-head live proof confirms the intended abort and no-reply outcome.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in semantics
options.body: Keep recall detection but require an explicit product/config direction before aborting active work by default.

options.title: Narrow to reply suppression
options.body: Avoid aborting in-flight agent work and retain only the safer post-recall delivery suppression behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve Feishu-local cancellation
recommendation.body: Accept recall as cancellation for Feishu source-bound work after current-head live proof confirms the intended abort and no-reply outcome.
